daily_summary_email:
This is the end-of-day report for {{store_name}} on {{date}}.

You completed {{sales_count}} sales and took in {{revenue}}. After the cost of the goods sold, gross profit is {{profit}}.

Expenses recorded for the day are {{expenses}}, so the net profit is {{net_profit}}.

Customers returned {{returns_count}} sale(s), worth {{returned_amount}}.

These figures follow completed sales, approved returns and expenses recorded for this store. Use them to see what came in, what went out, and what remained.
deleted_record_looked_like: This is what the record looked like when it was deleted:
invalid_grn_id: Goods received note is not valid.
log_recorded_before_history: This entry was recorded before field-by-field history, so only what was saved can be shown — not a before and after.
manual_activity_body: Tools → Activity logs opens a record the way a history entry should: who did it, when, and from where. Where the system stored the previous values, the window shows each field before and after. Older entries that were saved as a single note still open, with a note that a before-and-after was not stored.
manual_appearance_body: Appearance now has a light and a dark page surface, separate from the accent colour. Page titles and their descriptions stay left aligned on every screen.
manual_daily_summary_body: Turn on Daily summary under Settings → Notifications. At the end of the business day the store owner receives a report of sales, revenue, expenses, net profit and returns. The email carries the full explanation. The SMS is kept within two message credits. You can also turn on a warning when the subscription is within seven days of ending, and SMS for purchases, stock transfers, stock adjustments, new users and cloud backup.
manual_messaging_body: Each SMS gateway has two sender IDs: one for messages you write to customers, and one for system messages such as alerts and the daily report. If the system sender is left blank, the business sender is used. On Account & Top-up, only the developer account can see the gateway name, the sender IDs, and buy credit directly where the gateway allows it. Everyone else sends a top-up request, which is saved as a support ticket. Recently sent messages can be searched, filtered by status, and limited to a date range.
manual_modals_body: View windows for sales, purchases, inventory, expenses, users and messages are large enough to read the record without opening a second page. Lists hide columns that repeat the same detail.
manual_purchases_body: A new purchase order uses the full page, in the same way an invoice does, so supplier, items, costs and totals stay visible while you work.
manual_returns_body: A credit return changes the customer's debit only after the return is approved. The returned value, including tax, is the old invoice total minus the new invoice total. If nothing was paid, the debit stays for the goods the customer kept, and a full return cancels the debit. If a partial payment still covers the goods that remain, the amount due is the new total minus what was paid. If the customer already paid more than the goods left, the debit closes and the extra is refunded by the return's method. A credit note reduces the customer balance and can take it below zero. Cash sales have no debit.
manual_subscription_body: Paying 6 to 11 months is 10% off. Paying 12 to 23 months is 15% off, the same as paying for a year. Paying 24 months is 20% off.
manual_whats_new_intro: The PDF is the full guide. This page follows the language you selected and describes the behaviour that is in the system today.
months_to_pay_hint: Enter 1 to 24. From 6 months the discount is 10%. From 12 months it is 15%, the same as paying for a year. 24 months is 20% off.
no_record_changed: No field-by-field change was stored for this action.
notification_channels_note: The end-of-day summary goes to the store owner. The email can be as long as it needs to be. The SMS stays within two message credits. Direct SMS credit purchase and the gateway name stay on the developer account.
